text:
incident-bot: PAGER: billing.emitter.lag HIGH (3m) - token counts delayed and overage flags firing for subset of customers. Severity: P2. Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/emit-lag

Carla (oncall): I'm on it, looking at emitter metrics for eu1. Acks.

Ben (billing): FYI customer ops is already seeing several overage alerts in the console (IDs: C-1134, C-1178). Notified account teams.

Carla (oncall): Quick snapshot: emitter queue depth spiked ~09:02 UTC, kv-cache heartbeat for emitter downstream is missing since 09:00. Confirming whether this is a consumer lag or producer side.

Alice (eng-infra): I see a recent infra deploy rolled out at 08:58 -> `service/emit-proxy: v2.14.3` to eu1. Logs show repeated `kvcache: prefix scan timeout` errors around 09:00. Possible regression.

Eve (eng-runtime): Adding: runtime reports increased tokenization failures for one shard which may be backpressuring emitter. Looking at the runtime trace now.

Carla (oncall): Triage plan: 1) Pause external overage alerts (temp) 2) Switch traffic for emitter to fallback path 3) Kick off backfill for missing hour 09:00-09:10 4) If deploy is culprit -> rollback.

Dan (cs): Please confirm if we should post a customer-facing note. Some customers have already pinged support.

Ben (billing): Pause alerts: YES. CS please hold on outbound comms until we have ETA for backfill. We should avoid alarm-fatigue.

Carla (oncall): I ran quick queries: 
```SELECT service, count(*) as failures
FROM emitter_logs
WHERE ts >= '2026-03-20T08:55:00Z' AND ts < '2026-03-20T09:10:00Z'
GROUP BY service;
```
Result: emit-proxy has 14k failures, emit-writer OK.

Alice (eng-infra): I'm reverting the 08:58 deploy to v2.14.2 in eu1 now (rollback started). Will watch for kv-heartbeat recovery.

Eve (eng-runtime): Routed 30% of emitter traffic to fallback path (fallback-emitter) to reduce pressure, doubling consumer concurrency for backfill worker.

Carla (oncall): Paused overage alert rule `billing_overage_alert_v2` at 09:12 UTC. Created incident ticket INC-2026-455 and linked to this thread.

Dan (cs): Noted. I'll prepare a short internal customer note: "We are investigating delayed usage reporting affecting a subset of customers in EU region. No billing adjustments have been applied yet. We'll update shortly." Hold until we confirm backfill ETA.

Ben (billing): Once backfill completes we need a reconciliation run and then to undo paused alerts. Also capture list of impacted accounts for credit assessment.

Carla (oncall): Backfill job kicked at 09:18 UTC, running with increased parallelism. ETA ~ 18-25 minutes for 10m window. If rollback removes kvcache timeouts we should see emitter queue drain within 2 minutes of deploy completing.

Alice (eng-infra): Rollback finished at 09:16 UTC, kv-heartbeat recovered at 09:17:08. Seeing much lower error rate.

Eve (eng-runtime): Backfill progress: 40% complete. No duplicate emissions expected (dedupe id present). Logging backfill job ID: bf-1839991111-1.

Carla (oncall): Good. Next steps: - Monitor backfill to 100% - Run reconciliation script: `scripts/recon_tokens.sh bf-1839991111-1` - Keep alerts paused until reconciliation passes - CS to ready external update after recon results

Dan (cs): Will stand by. Draft ready.

Ben (billing): After recon, prepare a list of accounts with overage flags and suspected missing tokens. We'll coordinate credits if necessary.

Carla (oncall): I'll update incident ticket and post final status when recon completes. For now status: Mitigations applied (rollback + fallback + backfill). Customer impact: delayed usage reporting and transient overage alerts; no final billing changes yet.

incident-bot: NOTE: Pager automatically cleared at 09:32 UTC (no further high error rate).
